title: Community Notes Across Platforms: Evaluating the Feasibility of Re-using Crowd-sourced Context Notes
abstract: arXiv:2611.33546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Crowdsourced fact-checking systems such as Community Notes can provide useful context for misleading content. Producing and rating new notes on such systems requires substantial contributor effort. However, the resulting context is typically confined to the post and platform for which it was created. We ask whether already-vetted notes can be reused when the same claims recur across posts and platforms.   To investigate this question, we construct a human-labelled dataset using Community Notes attached to X posts created during a one-week period and candidate posts retrieved from Bluesky. Within our observation window, 140 of 340 claims had at least one confirmed recurrence on Bluesky, showing that cross-platform note reuse is a substantial opportunity. Recurrence alone, however, does not establish whether reuse would provide timely context. A timing analysis shows that many relevant notes were already Helpful when matching Bluesky pos

translated_title: 跨平台的社区笔记：评估重复使用众包语境说明的可行性
translated_abstract: 诸如“社区笔记”这样的众包事实核查系统可以为误导性内容提供有用的语境说明。在此类系统上撰写和评价新笔记需要贡献者付出大量精力。然而，由此产生的语境说明通常仅限于其原本针对的帖子和平台。我们探讨当相同的说法在不同帖子和平台上反复出现时，已经过审核的笔记能否被重复使用。为研究这一问题，我们构建了一个人工标注的数据集，数据来自X平台上一周内创建的帖子所附带的社区笔记，以及从Bluesky检索到的候选帖子。在我们的观察窗口内，340条说法中有140条在Bluesky上至少有一次被确认的重复出现，这表明跨平台笔记重复使用是一个可观的机会。然而，仅凭重复出现并不能确定重复使用能否提供及时的语境信息。时间分析显示，许多相关笔记在匹配的Bluesky帖子出现时已经被评为“有帮助”。
tldr: 本研究通过人工标注数据集评估了跨平台重复使用已审核社区笔记的可行性，发现340条说法中有140条在Bluesky上重复出现，且许多相关笔记在匹配帖子出现时已具备“有帮助”评级，证明笔记复用是可行的机会。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a human-labelled dataset to evaluate the feasibility of re-using vetted Community Notes across platforms, finding that 140 of 340 claims recurred on Bluesky and many relevant notes were already rated Helpful when matching posts appeared, demonstrating that cross-platform note reuse is a substantial opportunity.
